doc.brief: Describes where [`Shortcut`](xref:gtk:Shortcut)s added to a [`ShortcutController`](xref:gtk:ShortcutController) get handled.
doc.md:
Describes where [`Shortcut`](xref:gtk:Shortcut)s added to a
[`ShortcutController`](xref:gtk:ShortcutController) get handled.

global.brief: Shortcuts are handled by the root widget.
global.md:
Shortcuts are handled by
  the root widget.

local.brief: Shortcuts are handled inside the widget the controller belongs to.
local.md:
Shortcuts are handled inside
  the widget the controller belongs to.

managed.brief: Shortcuts are handled by the first ancestor that is a [`ShortcutManager`](xref:gtk:ShortcutManager)
managed.md:
Shortcuts are handled by
  the first ancestor that is a [`ShortcutManager`](xref:gtk:ShortcutManager)
